fields.Name: T311 - Scheduling Overview Auto-Refresh Toggle
fields.Description: Tests the ToggleAutoRefresh feature (label + variant state flip) unique to the overview component — a stateful control not present in any generic grid/dashboard test.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and switch to the 'Scheduling' application, staying on its 'Dashboard' section. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. In the header actions there is an 'Auto: OFF' / 'Auto: ON' button (a circular-arrows icon). Click it and verify the label toggles between ON and OFF and the button's emphasis (primary vs secondary styling) changes accordingly. Toggling it once (and ideally back) is success — you do NOT need to observe an actual data refresh cycle.

judgeValidationCriteria: An 'Auto:' toggle button is visible in the Dashboard header actions
Clicking it flips the label between 'Auto: ON' and 'Auto: OFF' and visibly changes the button's active/inactive styling
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
